asked.prompt: Tell a friend how it went.

asked.prompt: What do you think this is for?

said.said: Honestly a fridge-magnet style word game for making funny sentences. I just played with it.
Nothing really broke. "somehow" after "situation" was a bit odd, and there was no clear way to finish or send the sentence.

asked.prompt: What did you try that didn't do what you expected?

said.said: Nothing failed. I only tapped two words. I didn't try to remove one or send the sentence, so I don't know if that works.

asked.prompt: Where did you stop, and why?

said.said: I stopped after "I can explain the situation somehow". It read like a finished joke and I couldn't see a send or done button. I also didn't scroll for one.
